scoring_justification: The headline quantities are produced by a full tight-binding optimization that cannot be rerun in the lightweight verifier environment; T1 recompute from raw artifacts is infeasible, so we compare the agent's self-reported properties to the paper's reported values with absolute tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for T1/T2 cluster properties (cohesion energy, band gap, bond count, margin, longest bond) from the paper's Table I
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table I, entries for T1 sym 3.3 Å, T2 sym 3.1/3.3 Å, T2 asym 3.1/3.3 Å
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the published table; validated against the reference solve.sh that reproduces these numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual paper-reported values for the same structures and cutoffs; they are the ground-truth target of reproduction.

hidden_assets.purpose: Jahn-Teller distortion structural criteria (gap near zero for T2 sym 3.3 and gap >0, bond count >=96 for T2 asym 3.3)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from the paper's description and Table I: T2 sym at 3.3 Å has gap=0.000 eV (degenerate), T2 asym at 3.3 Å has gap=0.103 eV and 96 bonds.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Logical constraints based on the paper's explicit data.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These follow directly from the paper's reported numbers and the Jahn-Teller distortion narrative.

outputs.description: Computed properties of the five Si45 cluster cases. Each entry contains the structure identifier, bond cutoff, cohesion energy, HOMO‑LUMO gap, number of bonds, bond margin, and longest bond length.

output_contract.notes: The agent’s computed values will be compared to hidden reference values from the original study. Tolerances are not disclosed. The Jahn‑Teller distortion of T2 at 3.3 Å is implicitly verified through the reported properties (gap, number of bonds).

steps.conditions: T2_sym_3.3 band_gap <= 0.02 AND T2_asym_3.3 band_gap > 0 AND T2_asym_3.3 num_bonds >= 96
